seo.title: Academy Athens: Build Your Site & AI Agents | Advisable
seo.description: Two in-person masterclasses in Athens, 24 & 25 September 2026. Day 1 is training with a live demo, day 2 is a hands-on workshop where you build your own case study with 1:1 guidance. Taught in Greek. Held at the Advisable offices in Κολωνός, Αθήνα.

seo.ogDescription: In-person masterclasses in Athens, 24 & 25 September 2026. Day 2 is a hands-on workshop with your own case study. Limited seats. Taught in Greek. Held at the Advisable offices in Κολωνός, Αθήνα.

audience.title: Who it's for
items: Managers who want to produce things themselves
workshopItems: You come with a real case: the site you want to build or the process you want to automate.
We work one to one with every participant on their own case, not on a showcase example.
At the end of the day each participant presents their case study to the group.
audience.workshopNote: Seats are limited precisely so we have time to sit down with each person individually.

needs.title: What you need
items: Your own laptop (Windows or macOS) and its charger. It is mandatory for day 2, which is a workshop, and useful on day 1 too. We do not provide computers on site.
needs.note: Tool subscriptions (Lovable, Claude) are not included in the price. We will send instructions before the seminar on what to activate: free tiers are enough to get started.
needs.wifi: WiFi: provided by Advisable — you don't need your own connection.

groups.title: Morning track

groups.title: Afternoon track

groups.title: For both

items.name: Πάνος Καλλάρας
items.bio: He has been building and shipping digital products and websites for businesses for two decades. In the seminar he shows you step by step, on your own project, how to go from idea to a live result.

items.name: Βασίλης Καλλάρας
items.bio: He works daily with AI agents, MCP and cloud automations inside real business processes. He shares practical solutions that make it into production, not theory.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.note: Seats per track are limited so we can work one to one with each participant.

items.a: No. The seminars are designed for people without a technical background.

items.q: What language is it taught in?
items.a: Language of instruction: Greek. For teams, we can run a dedicated session in English — ask us.

items.q: Is it in person or online?
items.a: In person at the Advisable head offices, Ηρούς 4, Κολωνός, opposite the Kapnergostasio, with limited seats.

items.q: Can I book only one track?
items.a: Yes, the morning and afternoon tracks are independent and do not overlap.

items.q: Will we work on my own project?
items.a: Yes. Day 2 is a workshop and we work one to one with every participant on their own case, which they present at the end.
Yes, your own laptop and charger. It is essential for day 2, which is a workshop. We do not provide computers on site.

The price is final and includes attendance on both days, the seminar material, the certificate of attendance and the post-seminar support. It does not include the subscriptions of the tools you will use.
After your booking we send you bank transfer or online payment details. Your seat is confirmed with the deposit.
Free cancellation up to 10 days before, with a full refund. After that, your seat can be moved to a future edition or transferred to someone else.

items.q: Will there be a video if I miss a day?
items.a: The seminar is hands-on and day 2 is a workshop, so it is not recorded. You do receive all the material, the notes and your own case study.
Ask us about subsidised training through the Greek public employment service (ΔΥΠΑ/ΛΑΕΚ) and we will tell you whether your programme is covered.
Your laptop, its charger and your ideas.
Yes, Advisable provides fast WiFi to all participants. You'll get the connection details when you arrive.
